sources.title: GitHub - unarbos/teutonic
sources.snippet: Teutonic is a king-of-the-hill pretraining system for Bittensor subnet 3. Miners submit immutable model checkpoints. The validator verifies each submission and sends the challenger and current king to a remote GPU evaluator for paired cross-entropy scoring. A successful challenger becomes the new king, and the validator updates subnet weights and publishes the resulting state.
